segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the emulsion is light and non-greasy, though one still found her skin oily by the next morning and another still felt shine develop during the day.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin describe it as sufficiently hydrating and gentle, with some using it specifically for dry winter skin or as a lighter daytime option before a heavier night cream.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report it balances hydration without shine or greasiness and works well across seasons.
segments.sensitive: The large majority of self-identified sensitive-skin reviewers, including those with rosacea, eczema, dermatitis or MCAS, report no irritation and good tolerance over months or years; a distinct minority of self-identified sensitive-skin reviewers instead report burning, stinging, itchy rash, white bumps or breakouts, often blamed on the fragrance.
segments.mature: Reviewers describing themselves as older or mature report smoother, plumper-looking skin and compliments on their appearance.

concerns.aging: Reviewers using it against aging report smoother texture, fewer visible lines, and a plumper, glowy look attributed to consistent use.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers report it relieves dehydrated skin quickly and keeps skin hydrated all day even though it is a light formula; one reviewer found it not hydrating enough for her skin and had to stop use.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with rosacea or redness-prone skin report it calms and controls redness without irritation, and several use it specifically as their rosacea routine staple.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer credits the product's barrier-repair claim with her skin feeling calmer, though she notes it may not be hydrating enough for all skin types needing heavier barrier support.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers, mostly with sensitive or acne-prone skin, report the moisturizer triggered breakouts, white bumps, or a reformulation-linked flare-up, while others with acne-prone or combination-oily-sensitive skin report no new breakouts at all.
concerns.oiliness: Multiple reviewers report the emulsion controls shine and doesn't feel oily or greasy, while a couple of oily-skin reviewers still noticed slickness or oiliness returning later in the day.

extraits.texte: After just one week of use, this product caused severe breakouts that took months to clear up. Unfortunately, I still have scars from the terrible acne it caused. Skin products are relative so, if you have sensitive skin, I would not recommend this product.

I have liked Avene products as they are generally mindful of eliminating harsh or irritating ingredients, and had high hope for this moisturizer. I was surprised with the strong scent. I tried it a few days hoping it might not be irritating. While it provided moisture, it also unfortunately caused some white bumps which is a definite negative reaction. Disappointed that Avene would add these ingredients. Unless you have skin that can tolerate anything, I could not recommend this.

I really enjoyed how light this went on however, I did not feel it was hydrating enough for my skin. Additionally, I developed a reaction to this lotion after about a week's time (burning/stinging) and am no longer able to use it on my face. I'm currently using it as a hand lotion so not to go to waste but will not repurchase once gone.

I have combination/oily/sensitive/acne prone skin. I am very very easily irritated by just about everything in skincare and this didn't irritate my skin. I did find the fragrance a bit strong upon application, but it faded pretty quickly to me. the packaging is a lot smaller than I expected for the price, but I didn't need a huge amount of product to get the job done. this moisturizer is moisturizing and helped my dehydrated skin. if your skin leans more dry or needs a heavy moisturizer then this IS NOT for you. this is very light weight which I can appreciate cause I hate the feeling of anything on my face. I don't wear make up so I can speak for how it wear under it. I will repurchase just because this is a really nice light weight product and hasn't caused my skin any acne, irritation, or sensitivity. usually I would use Peter Thomas Roth water drench cloud cream but I found it wasn't hydrating enough with my salicylic acid acne treatment.

I can't find a better moisturizer! Perfect for daily use. I have combination skin & eczema. This formula leaves you hydrated and without any shine. Lightweight, not greasy, barely any scent, absorbs fast, relieves dehydrated skin immediately, and helps alleviate eczema on the face. I use it in every season but sometimes combine it with the Thermal spring water or the Hydrance aqua gel if I'm extra dehydrated due to the weather. Never had any reactions to my skin

While I'm not currently using the Hydrance Light during winter, I bought it when a discount was offered in anticipation of spring and summer use. I've used it before and found it to be a perfect moisturizer for my Rosacea-prone skin which can still get a bit oily, even though I'm 68. I highly recommend it for it's non-irritating, light moisturizing.

Love this product! My skin is combination, and not sensitive, but I find that it gets red easily. I use this as a day lotion (rather than something a little heavier for nighttime), and it is perfect. It is so light, absorbs quickly, and doesn't feel greasy at all. Also, my face seems to be a little happier with the "barrier repair" claim. I don't think it would be hydrating enough for all skin types, but I love it for a lighter option.
